summary: BI-C64EDA33 PR 3 (AC-5, plan 2026-11-14-workroom-runtime-core). Migration 20261114080000_workroom_room_setup_effect adds the 'ensure-workitem-anchor' value to WorkroomEffectKind. Claim and adopt now owe a room its WorkItem anchor as a WorkroomEffect committed in the same transaction as the room (it used to be created after commit and could be lost to a crash); the effect worker runs and retries it. No new table or column.
affectedCopies: WorkroomEffect rows of kind ensure-workitem-anchor: inserted by apps/web/lib/workroom-runtime/room-setup-effects.server.ts inside the claim (governed-work-claim afterClaimInTx) and adopt transactions; run by the effect worker; cascade with their Workroom.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: the room's capsule id, backlog item id and title.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Covered by the WorkroomEffect model's telemetry-bounded lifecycle (180 days on createdAt).

migration.name: 20261114080000_workroom_room_setup_effect
migration.backfill: None. Rooms made before this change already have their anchor or get it from the existing anchor repair paths.
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive; an enum value cannot be dropped without recreating the type, and nothing requires dropping it.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Telemetry-bounded: settled rows are history of the room's runtime (180 days on createdAt); unsettled rows are live work. Cascades with its Workroom.

fields.reason: Enum gains ensure-workitem-anchor, a room setup step.
